personality_one_liner: A high-energy, tactical dark interface optimized for competitive gamers, blending utility-driven layouts with vibrant electric accents.

spacing.rule: Utility-first: stack modules tightly, use clear structural dividers, ensure safe area padding, and keep metrics glanceable.

do's: Floating action buttons and live match status pills
dont's: Dense statistical grids in the profile

screens.name: Home / Discover
screens.purpose: A dashboard for quick actions, live H2H matches, and sponsored tournament discovery.

states.loading: Centered loading spinner with 'Syncing arena...' text.
states.empty: Brand-tinted icon with 'No live events right now. Create a challenge!' and a primary CTA.

screens.layout: Hero carousel at the top showing sponsored events using dark glass cards. Two-column grid below for quick actions (Wallet Deposit, Create H2H). A vertically scrolling list for upcoming matches.

screens.name: Tournaments
screens.purpose: List and filter all public, private, and sponsored tournaments.

states.empty: Abstract tournament illustration, 'No tournaments match your filters', and clear filters CTA.
states.error: Failed to load brackets error with retry CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky glass segmented control (Public, Invite, Sponsored) at the top. Full-width cards containing prize pools, player count, and registration status. The primary 'Register' CTA must be prominent inside the detail view.

screens.name: Play / H2H
screens.purpose: Matchmaking interface to create or accept head-to-head challenges.

states.empty: No active challenges. Large central 'Create Challenge' pill.
states.error: Matchmaking failed to connect. Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Filter bar (Game, Region, Console) followed by a live rail of pending challenges. When a match is active, the screen transforms into a live tracking mode with a sticky 'Report Result' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Wallet
screens.purpose: Secure hub for balance, deposits, withdrawals, and platform fee history.

states.empty: No transaction history. 'Make your first deposit' CTA.
states.error: Unable to reach payment provider. Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Large hero card at the top displaying available and pending balances (surfaceSecondary with brandTertiary tint). Two side-by-side buttons for Deposit/Withdraw. A grouped list below for transaction history with green/white metrics for +/- values.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Showcase user statistics, match history, badges, and account settings.

states.empty: New account state. 'Play a match to build your stats'.

screens.layout: Profile cover image with an avatar layered over it. A horizontal scroll of badges, followed by a dense 2x2 grid for metrics (K/D, Win Rate, Earnings). Stacked rows for Match History and settings navigation.

home_hero_bg.alt: Dark dimly lit esports gaming arena

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility personality. The app should feel like a high-performance tactical dashboard for gamers.
Use Neon Lime/Electric Green (#CCFF00) as the primary brand color paired with deep obsidian/carbon surfaces. Do not use any shades of blue/indigo to strictly comply with the no-blue mandate.
Implement a persistent bottom tab navigation (Home, Tournaments, Play/H2H, Wallet, Profile) with glassmorphic backgrounds.

For the H2H and Tournament creation/action flows, the primary CTA (e.g., 'Submit Result', 'Register') MUST be sticky at the bottom of the screen above the Safe Area, backed by a gradient/glass backdrop.

When displaying background images on cards (e.g., Sponsored Tournaments, Featured H2H Matches), you MUST apply a top-to-bottom linear gradient scrim (transparent to 70%+ surfaceInverse) to guarantee text legibility.
Use Rajdhani (condensed/angular) for all headers, metrics, scores, and prize pools to create an authentic esports feel. Use Satoshi for standard body text.
The UI should use tight structural padding (spacing scale sm/md) with visible dividers (border 1pt) and avoid drop shadows entirely. Depth is created via tonal blocks and glass.
Never center align dense statistical data or tournament details; use strong left-alignment and tabular numerical styling for scores/earnings.
